reports.name: Ricky Tiedemann
reports.peak_summary: Projection: depth arm with high risk. The current pitching shape is bat missing over 32 IP.
reports.published_report: Ricky Tiedemann is a high-spin starter with elite strikeout stuff who is fighting to return from Tommy John surgery and a full missed 2025 season. His 32 IP at AA this year show 16.3 K/9 (99th percentile) and 26% K-BB%, but control is a live problem: 5.6 BB/9 and a 5.06 ERA reflect walks and contact management issues that predate surgery. The core risk is durability and time; he remains on the injured list as of late June 2026, and his minor-league sample remains thin and prior-season-heavy. Confidence is low given the injury status, the control volatility, and the fact that only 32 IP has come back so far.
